scope: 从已取得导出中选取可见用户/助手消息；不含内部推理、工具日志或授权码。不声称完整平台记录；保留来源顺序，文件之间可能重叠。子代理初始指令未必由导出接口返回；不能据助手回复条数推定实现调用次数。

messages.text: I’ll read the diff, calculate the required finding count, and check for missing behavior as well as defects.

The backend transaction and filter logic look consistent so far. I’m focusing next on recovery states and how the new controls interact with the existing room editor, where the tests cover fewer combinations.

- Finding floor: 1,954,686 bytes ÷ 1,000 = 1,954.686 kB; N = min(⌊√1,954.686 + 1⌋, 10) = **10**.
- [blocks.js:131](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:131) silently rounds valid 64-bit room IDs through `Number()`. For example, selecting `9007199254740993` sends `9007199254740992`, potentially creating a block for another existing room. Reject unsafe integers explicitly or preserve IDs losslessly; documenting the precision boundary does not prevent a wrong-room mutation.
- [blocks.js:67](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:67) maintains authentication failure state independently from the existing room editor. If a room-editor request discovers session expiry or lost administrator privileges, previously loaded full booking/block records remain displayed and the new controls remain enabled. Share the authentication-loss event across both modules and test both detection directions.
- [admin.html:44](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/admin.html:44) leaves the new creation form usable when its JavaScript fails to load. Its default submission is a GET to `/admin`, which puts the entered maintenance reason and times into the URL and loses the draft without creating anything. Disable submission until initialization succeeds and provide an explicit unavailable-JavaScript message.
- [blocks.js:155](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:155) tells users to query before resubmitting an unknown result, but retains the checked confirmation and immediately reenables submission. Another click can issue a second POST without any reconciliation. Represent the unknown-result state explicitly, clear confirmation, and provide a deliberate query-and-review recovery action.
- [blocks.js:106](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:106) does not retain or display the criteria used for the visible results. After changing a filter, old records and their successful count remain beneath the new selections, with no indication that they belong to the previous query. Display the executed criteria or mark results stale until the next query.
- [blocks.js:119](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/blocks.js:119) discards the server’s field-specific query errors. For example, the date input permits `9999-12-31`, but the server rejects it with a useful `fields.date` explanation that the page never shows. Add inline filter errors, `aria-invalid`, and focus handling equivalent to the creation form.
- [tests/test_blocks_js.cjs:9](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_blocks_js.cjs:9) builds a refresh-button stub but never invokes its handler; the browser verifier also never clicks that button. Add coverage for newly created rooms appearing in all three selectors, selected-room and draft preservation, confirmation invalidation, and refresh failure/timeout recovery.
- [verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs:84](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs:84) labels a query `manual-confirm-unknown` but only checks that no extra POST occurred and the draft survived. It never asserts that the committed block appears in the response and rendered list. Capture the committed block ID and assert that the recovery query actually exposes that exact record.
- [verify_maintenance_block_browser.py:125](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_maintenance_block_browser.py:125) checks only surviving original reservations. Deleting an original reservation and its slots can pass this assertion because absent IDs are never examined. Assert equality of the complete original-ID set and every original row before validating newly created records.
- [verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs:43](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_maintenance_block_browser.cjs:43) verifies full DTO keys in HTTP responses, but does not verify that the complete records are displayed. Removing owner, purpose, creation time, or cancellation/revocation details from `render()` could leave these checks passing. Compare rendered field labels and values against the fixtures for both record types and terminal states.
